changes_made.explanation: Removed 'Dialogue Generation' as it's not the main task. Removed 'grammar-based natural language generator' as it's part of the interaction framework, not the NLG model being evaluated. Removed 'natural language questions for user interaction' as these are generated by the system for interaction, not the primary NLG output being evaluated. The paper focuses on semantic parsing (text-to-SQL generation) as the main NLG task.

Normalized all variations of 'exact match' to 'Exact Match'. Kept only the canonical form to avoid redundancy. The paper uses exact match accuracy as the primary automatic metric for evaluating generated SQL queries.
No LLMs are used as judges in this paper. The paper was published in 2020 before LLM-as-judge approaches became common.
The paper does not conduct human evaluations. All evaluations are automated using exact match accuracy with gold-standard SQL queries.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on interactive learning for semantic parsing (text-to-SQL generation). Evaluation is entirely automated using exact match accuracy against gold SQL queries. No human evaluation or LLM-as-judge methods are used. The extraction was generally accurate but included some peripheral components of the interactive framework rather than focusing on the core NLG task being evaluated.
